body.prompt: The same Korean woman in her early sixties at a family dinner table, relatives talking to her with well-meaning faces, she looks down at her untouched rice bowl, holding back tears, warm dim light. Same painterly cinematic oil-painting texture and fine film grain, but a cool desaturated blue-grey palette with only one small warm light, horizontal 16:9 widescreen film frame, main subject in the middle band of the frame, nothing important in the top and bottom eighth of the frame, faces clearly lit. Absolutely no text, no letters, no numbers, no readable screens, no watermark, no brands anywhere.
